FIELD NOTES

Getting to know Gerie

Use Gerie's Terra element as a starting point for finding teammates. Then check each candidate’s current skill descriptions: who benefits, what activates the effect, and whether it supports the way you want to play.

Rarity alone does not determine the best choice for your account. Before investing, compare the resources needed with the specific problem you are trying to solve. Try a consistent encounter and change one part of your setup at a time.

Before investing

  • Read the current skills and their activation conditions.
  • Identify the team slot and purpose you want to fill.
  • Test the interaction before committing limited materials.
  • Compare with alternatives you already own.
Profile scope
